## Figure

## Statistical results

| group | n | events | median_survival | ci_low | ci_high | log_rank_p |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| control | 60 | 45 | 6.8 | 4.6 | 10.1 | 0.00700203369548444 |
| treated | 60 | 30 | 11.4 | 9.3 | 19.2 | 0.00700203369548444 |

## Methods

Survival was estimated by the Kaplan-Meier method and compared between groups of arm with the log-rank test (chi-square(1) = 7.27, P = 0.007). Median survival by group: control (median  6.8), treated (median 11.4). Censoring is marked with ticks and the number at risk is tabulated below the curves; it counts the subjects whose time is at or after each time point. Analyses were performed in R 4.4.1 with survival 3.6.4 and survminer 0.4.9.
